name: player_start_master_type_loop_sfx_handle
description: zUtil_SaveGameState::StartMasterTypeLoopSfxHandle starts a master-common loop sample and stores the returned play handle.
known_limits: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?StartMasterTypeLoopSfxHandle@zUtil_SaveGameState@@QAEPAUzSndPlayHandle@@HM@Z at 0x4385a0 currently fails with 61 unmasked mismatches after masking 4 relocation bytes; Binary Ninja body is 66 bytes, the VC object symbol is 64 bytes with 6 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed, and the triage artifact is build/vc5-verify/player_start_master_type_loop_sfx_handle/verify/4385a0_byte_triage.txt.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x4385a0 shows thiscall shape: ECX is zUtil_SaveGameState, stack arguments are modeIndex and sfxVolume, and the callee returns with retn 8.

The function passes nullptr as the world position for modeIndex 3, otherwise passes &playerState->worldPos, calls masterCommonData->sfxWeaponUp[modeIndex]->PlayA3D(worldPos, sfxVolume, nullptr), stores the returned zSndPlayHandle in playerState->modeLoopSfxHandle[modeIndex], and returns it.

The native smoke exercises the DirectSound-backed PlayA3D path for modeIndex 3, verifies the returned handle is stored in the indexed modeLoopSfxHandle slot, verifies owner-sample propagation, and verifies markerBaseTime reset.
